name: Zero Gravity Chairs Lounge Patio Folding Recliner
material: powder coated steel frame w/t 2*1 teslin fabric
description: Take a vacation on the beach or rest beside the poolside with our zero gravity chairs! These high quality zero gravity chairs are great for beach, courtyard, poolside or indoor places. With a folding design, you only need to leave a space for it in your trunk and our recliners can accompany you anywhere and anytime. The ergonomic headrest and high-elastic bungee ropes provide comfortable support. And the adjustable design with a locking system allows you to choose a suitable angle to satisfy your various needs. What's more, the removable tray can be assembled on both sides of the chair for convenient use. And the powder-coated frame with quick-drying fabric makes maintenance effortless. Enjoy leisure time with family and friends!
